node.statement: If epsilon_lambda tends to 0 and every stochastic-idempotent approximation error is at least (1/sqrt(2))*sqrt(epsilon_lambda), then for every beta>1/2 and every fixed C>0 the ratio of this lower bound to C*epsilon_lambda^beta is (1/(C*sqrt(2)))*epsilon_lambda^(1/2-beta), which tends to infinity. Thus no uniform O(epsilon^beta) bound with beta>1/2 can hold on this family, establishing intrinsic square-root-order sharpness.
